QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_44

question.text: Jeevan Jyoti Foundation runs a maternal-health program. When selecting standards under the SAS Framework, the SIA should choose:

answer.text: The relevant thematic SAS such as SAS 200 for healthcare to pick domain-appropriate indicators
Only the Companies Act 2013 Section 135 CSR rules
Only the SEBI ICDR Regulation 292B eligible-activities list

explanation.text: The Logic: The SAS Framework includes thematic standards. SAS 200 is the healthcare thematic standard and applies directly to a maternal-health program. CSR, ICDR and 80G are ancillary regulatory references, not the primary indicator source. The Trap: CSR/ICDR/80G govern eligibility and tax but do not provide outcome indicators for healthcare programs. Note: SAS 100 is the hunger/poverty/malnutrition/inequality thematic standard; SAS 200 is the healthcare thematic standard. Pick the SAS that matches the program's theme.
